scope.includes: Every specific member of the 17 surveyed type libraries: methods, property accessors, events, interfaces, coclasses, aliases and enumerations. Includes detected secondary extensions and auxiliary libraries.
scope.completeness: Complete with respect to the libraries listed in this file. It does not guarantee every possible interface of every Control Expert version or optional component.
excludes: Internal functions without COM metadata; arbitrary native DLL exports.
Every third-party COM library installed by FDT/DTM.
IEC EF/EFB/DFB blocks as if they were automation methods; their catalogs are reached through UnityProLibset and UnityProServer.
Complete PLC protocol specifications (Modbus/UMAS) or XML exchange schemas.

intentional_omissions.reason: Listed per interface but not repeated as business operations.

scope.documentation_status: The original text of each type library is preserved; interpreted descriptions are marked. The signature does not specify the internal schema of every VARIANT nor every precondition.
scope.support: Private, internal and tests are categories derived from names. Technical detection does not establish an API publicly supported by Schneider.
scope.validation: Static metadata read with LoadTypeLibEx(REGKIND_NONE). Control Expert was not instantiated and no project or PLC operation was invoked.

how_to_read.functions: Flat list; id = library.interface.member:accessor (method, get, put or putref). Getters and setters have separate entries. Callbacks of event interfaces have kind=event.
how_to_read.io: inputs and outputs contain names; parameters keeps order, direction, COM type, optionality and default value when present. inout appears in both groups.
how_to_read.return: The return declared by ITypeInfo. On dispatch interfaces it may be the logical Automation value; on vtable interfaces it may be HRESULT with the result travelling as an [out, retval] parameter.
how_to_read.types: BSTR=Unicode string; LONG=32-bit COM integer; SHORT=16 bits; VARIANT_BOOL=COM boolean; VARIANT=dynamic value; SAFEARRAY=COM array; *=pointer. User-defined types include the library to avoid name collisions.
how_to_read.location: Type library path or numbered DLL resource DLL\n, GUID, type index, interface name and member. Indices are zero-based.
how_to_read.access: Indicative path inferred from the registry and typed returns. <parameters> are placeholders; paths are not tested code. QueryInterface may be needed for secondary interfaces.
how_to_read.events: Callbacks the client must implement; they are not automation commands.
how_to_read.documentation: original_documentation is extracted from the vendor. description_source distinguishes type library text, name interpretation and absence of detailed semantics.
how_to_read.errors: The type library has no exhaustive error contract. Check HRESULT/EXCEPINFO when invoking; no codes or JSON output schemas are invented.
